About JAMES WILD HERBS

An ISO 9001: 2008 certified organization, we, John Aromas, are one of the renowned Manufacturers and Suppliers of a wide assortment of Herbal Extracts, Herbal Essential Oil, Fragrance, Aromatic Essential Oils, Water Soluble Product, and more. We are having high expertise in identification, extraction and processing of naturally active ingredients from rare Indian herbs. Our valuable products are widely sourced by renowned clients from Pharmaceutical, FMCG, Ayurvedic, Beverage and Cosmetics Industries. All our herbal products are vital for human health for which these are widely exported to foreign markets of North US, UAE, Asia, Southeast Asia etc.
